June 10 Sam. Artz - 35 - Apendicitis and gall-blader ten yrs. ago ... Has not been well since.
Page 215 June 10th + Mrs. Nina Clark - 42 - nephritus "hopeless!" Drs. Say To-day Mrs. Mary Walker - 60 - fearfully threatening foot & ankle ulcer 11th Mrs Nina Clark as above - reported decidedly improved - Drs. can hardly believe Eyes.
Joseph Cloutier - 62 - Operation wonderfully successful ... . toumer removed from bladder.
Mary Louria - 40 - Extremely nerveous.
Fr. Lambert's Brother out of work
Helena Pienta - 42 - prayed for before - 3rd operation for a time so much feared, now believed not necessary.
Peter O'Grady - 18 - Stomach - now spinal maninjitis - Drs. wonder that he still lives - Mother promises over phone to read ... 'City of God
Rosario Masse - 35 - professor out of work - wife and 3 small chil. depending .... has good promises ....
Page 216 June
Clarence Fisher - 20 - Epalytic. Leo Zimmith - 33 - conversion
Mrs. Joseph Blust - 78 - cancer feared - daughter - "good shepherdess Mr. Cyril Dobusschere - 57 - fearful asthma - At times nearly smothers ....
15 Richard Ireland - 32 - Lukemia - Enrolled and prayed for May 12 - noted mother reading "City of God" - Here To-day remarkedly improved Grace Cotter - 37
